相关性: 该论文提出了一种具有后验误差估计的算子学习方法，可显著提升有限元代理模型的采样效率和可靠性，对植入物生物力学设计中的代理建模具有直接借鉴价值。
边界: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical or implant mechanics, nor does it include any biomechanical context or implant-specific validation.
动机· 提高算子学习代理模型的可靠性和采样效率。
方法· 结合降基方法与神经算子，构建变分一致的代理模型并推导后验误差估计。
结果· 在多个基准问题上验证了误差估计的有效性和代理模型的准确性。
验证· 通过数值基准测试验证了方法的性能。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To enhance the reliability and sampling efficiency of operator learning surrogates for parametric PDEs.
Method· A reduced basis neural operator is developed with a variational consistency and an a posteriori error estimator to guide training and quantify prediction error.
Result· The proposed method demonstrates accurate predictions and reliable error bounds on several benchmark problems.
Validation· The approach is validated through numerical benchmarks on standard PDE problems.

相关性: 该论文提出的DeepONet增强iFEM的混合方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，用于稀疏传感下的全场应力应变重建。
边界: 该论文未涉及植入物或生物力学场景，未进行实验验证，且未处理多目标优化或约束，仅针对复合材料层合板的数值基准。
动机· 解决稀疏传感下全场应力应变重建难题，克服iFEM对密集测量的依赖。
方法· 提出DeepONet增强应变数据与iFEM结合的两步框架，利用刚度矩阵条件化处理层合板变异性。
结果· 在400种层合板配置上实现未见铺层的高精度应变重建，支持后续完整性评估。
验证· 基于数值悬臂复合板基准，涵盖对称、非对称等多样铺层。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To overcome the limitation of iFEM requiring dense strain measurements for full-field reconstruction, this work integrates operator learning to augment sparse sensor data.
Method· A two-step framework is introduced where a DeepONet conditioned on laminate stiffness matrices predicts missing strain values, which are then fed into iFEM to compute displacements and stresses under physical constraints.
Result· The approach accurately reconstructs strain fields across unseen laminate configurations, demonstrating generalizability within a mechanically diverse family of composite plates.
Validation· The method is validated on a numerical benchmark of a cantilever composite plate with 400 laminate configurations, covering symmetric, unsymmetric, balanced, and unbalanced layups.

动机· 为减轻复合材料箱梁设计计算负担，需快速预测屈曲强度。
方法· 基于有限元生成数据库，训练贝叶斯正则化ANN，以五个无量纲参数为输入预测屈曲强度。
结果· ANN预测误差小（平均3.01%），计算时间从300秒降至0.01秒以下。

Motivation· To reduce the computational cost of designing stiffened FRP box-beams, a fast and accurate prediction of global flange buckling strength is needed.
Method· A Bayesian regularized artificial neural network was trained on a finite element generated database, using five dimensionless parameters derived from laminate theory as inputs.
Result· The ANN achieved an average prediction error of 3.01% and reduced computation time from about 300 seconds to less than 0.01 seconds per prediction.
Validation· The model was validated against finite element simulation results, with no experimental or physical testing involved.

边界: This paper does not address biomedical implant mechanics, nor does it validate on any biomechanical or implant-related case, and it lacks experimental validation.
动机· 数字孪生需要快速全阶仿真，传统代理模型仅为近似，量子计算有望加速。
方法· 提出量子有限元法（QFEM）结合MCMC-MH贝叶斯推断，用于梁结构刚度退化参数识别。

验证· 通过与传统有限元结果对比及数值模拟验证模型精度。

Motivation· Digital twins require real-time full-order simulations, but traditional surrogates are only approximations, motivating the use of quantum computing to accelerate finite element analysis.
Method· The study integrates a quantum finite element method (QFEM) with a Metropolis-Hastings Markov Chain Monte Carlo algorithm for Bayesian inference to update a beam model and estimate stiffness degradation.
Result· QFEM achieves accuracy comparable to classical FEM and successfully identifies posterior distributions of structural parameters, demonstrating its potential for digital twin model updating.
Validation· The approach is validated by comparing QFEM results with traditional FEM solutions and by numerical simulation of the Bayesian updating procedure.

边界: This paper does not address implant mechanics, bone remodeling, or any biomedical FEA context; it focuses on urban pollutant dispersion, and lacks uncertainty quantification and constraint handling for design optimization.
动机· 降低城市环境高分辨率测量成本，准确估计流场和污染物浓度。

Motivation· To reduce the high cost of high-resolution measurements in urban environments while accurately estimating mean flow and pollutant concentration fields.
Method· A two-step physics-informed neural network framework is proposed, where the first step reconstructs the mean flow field and estimates eddy viscosity from sparse velocity data, and the second step uses these as fixed fields to solve the advection-diffusion equation for pollutant concentration.
Result· The two-step approach improves accuracy and reduces data requirements, and L-BFGS optimization outperforms Adam for ill-conditioned loss landscapes.
Validation· Validation is performed using large eddy simulation data for a two-dimensional street canyon, with no experimental measurements.

结果· 两种技术在种植体存活率和骨吸收方面无显著差异，压电手术改善二次稳定性但手术时间更长。
验证· 基于已发表系统综述的二次分析，无原始实验验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate whether piezosurgery offers clinical advantages over conventional sequential osteotomy for dental implant site preparation.
Method· An umbrella review of nine systematic reviews was conducted following PRISMA guidelines, with methodological quality assessed using AMSTAR 2 and Glenny checklists.
Result· Implant survival and marginal bone loss were comparable between techniques; piezosurgery improved secondary stability and postoperative comfort but required longer operative time.
Validation· No experimental validation; the study is a secondary analysis of existing systematic reviews.

Motivation· To evaluate the clinical performance of 45S5 bioactive glass as a bone graft substitute in benign lytic bone lesions.
Method· A case series of 9 patients underwent intralesional curettage followed by cavity filling with 45S5 bioactive glass, with postoperative radiographic assessment of osseointegration.
Result· Most patients showed good to partial osseointegration with low complication rates.
Validation· Clinical case series (Level IV evidence) with qualitative radiographic evaluation.

Motivation· To develop a 3D-bioprinted hydrogel patch for sealing postoperative pulmonary air leaks.

动机· 利用植物提取物绿色合成金纳米颗粒并评估其生物活性。
方法· 使用Grewia tenax茎皮提取物还原合成金纳米颗粒，并通过多种光谱和显微技术表征。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To develop a green synthesis method for gold nanoparticles using plant extract and evaluate their potential biomedical applications.
Method· Gold nanoparticles were synthesized using Grewia tenax stem bark extract and characterized by UV-Vis, FTIR, TEM, Zeta potential, and BET surface area analysis.
Result· The synthesized gold nanoparticles exhibited significant antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anticancer activities against various pathogens and cancer cell lines.
Validation· Validation was performed through physicochemical characterization and in vitro assays including antimicrobial tests, DPPH radical scavenging, and MTT cell proliferation assay.
